hypotheses: All eight fixed cases reach a terminal artifact without silent exclusion.
The R149 Q13 planner timeout does not recur under the explicit 180-second planner contract.
The R149 Q21 shared-ledger collision does not recur with shard-local ledger authorities.
Every successful case records live LLM, retrieval and structured-data fidelity plus trajectory, budget and evidence-funnel locators.

selection_rationale.Q21: prior shared-ledger collision and industry evidence volume
selection_rationale.Q30: hard event timeline and disclosure timing

decision_rules.pass: 8 terminal cases, zero planner timeouts, zero ledger collisions, zero silent exclusions, and all successful cases have three-layer live fidelity plus required locators
decision_rules.failure: Preserve any terminal failure without rerun or replacement and route its defect class to F12
decision_rules.quality_claim: No canary score or funnel ratio proves product acceptance or capability effectiveness

stop_conditions: sum of shard ledgers reaches CNY 12
either shard reaches its CNY 6 fuse
credentials or third-party response bodies would leave ignored artifacts
rollback: Preserve every terminal and partial artifact, stop dependent paid work, and do not rerun a failed case.
